plans.idea: Faithful vertical translation of the original: logo crowns the top, the bottle gets a large central stage, then headline and legal line, then the flavour/CTA chips as one centred block at the bottom, so it reads top to bottom like the square.

Headline-first story: the logo and a big two-line headline open the frame, the bottle sits under it as proof, and the chip block with Build Your Mix closes at thumb height, so message, product and action come in that order.

Product-poster layout: the bottle fills the top half edge to edge as the dominant image, the headline and chip menu sit under it as one tight block, and the logo signs off at the bottom like a poster lockup.
